# SCP Helper / VogApp

> Fast context for LLMs working on this repository. Read this before exploring the
> whole tree.

## Project Summary

This is a small Django 4.2 web app for a rowing club. Users log in, view a
weekly calendar of concrete rowing slots, and create/cancel complete-crew boat
bookings. Staff/admin users manage athletes, slots, boats, workouts, and
bookings. Login users are managed from Django's built-in admin.

The Django project package is `vogapp`; the main app is `bookings`.

## High-Signal Files

- `README.md`: setup, deployment, environment variables, and current domain overview.
- `pyproject.toml` / `requirements.txt`: Python and dependency constraints.
- `vogapp/settings.py`: environment loading, database config, security flags,
  email settings, static file setup, auth redirects.
- `vogapp/urls.py`: root URL wiring, login/logout, and inclusion of bookings URLs.
- `bookings/models.py`: core data model:
  - `Athlete`: sports identity, optionally linked to a Django `User`.
  - `Workout`: reusable workout label/description.
  - `SlotBatch`: recurrence helper used to generate concrete slots.
  - `Slot`: concrete date/time interval, optionally linked to one workout.
  - `Boat`: boat name, rower seats, optional cox requirement, active/color metadata.
  - `Booking`: one boat reserved for one slot.
  - `BookingCrewMember`: through model for rower seats and cox role.
- `bookings/forms.py`: main business validation for complete crews and no double-booking.
- `bookings/views.py`: calendar, booking/cancel flow, admin athlete/slot/booking screens,
  and custom throttled login.
- `bookings/urls.py`: route names and URL structure.
- `bookings/notifications.py`: recipient collection and email body generation for
  booking lifecycle events.
- `bookings/tests.py`: executable specification for slot batches, athlete management,
  complete crew validation, notifications, permissions, and rendered booking visibility.
- `setup_initial_data.py`: seeds workouts, boats, current-month slots, and the first admin user.
- `render.yaml`: Render deployment config.

## Lower-Signal Files For Initial Comprehension

You can usually skip these until changing UI, styling, deployment plumbing, or
schema history:

- `bookings/static/bookings/css/*.css`: styling only.
- `bookings/static/bookings/js/nav.js`: navigation behavior only.
- `bookings/templates/**/*.html`: presentation layer.
- `bookings/migrations/*.py`: generated schema history. This project intentionally
  reset migrations after a destructive model redesign.
- `vogapp/wsgi.py`: standard deployment entry point.
- `bookings/__init__.py`, `vogapp/__init__.py`,
  `bookings/templatetags/__init__.py`: package markers.
- `.venv/`, `.mypy_cache/`, `.virtual_documents/`, `data/`, `notebooks/`,
  `db.sqlite3`, `staticfiles/`: local/runtime/generated data. Do not treat as
  source of truth.

## Runtime Model

- Authentication uses Django's built-in `User`.
- `Athlete` is the rowing/sports person model and may exist without a linked user.
- `Athlete.user` is an optional one-to-one link to `User`.
- App-level admin screens create and edit athletes. Django users are created only
  from `/django-admin/` and can optionally be linked to athletes.
- Staff/admin is defined by `user.is_staff or user.is_superuser`.
- Main user-facing pages require login.
- App-level admin pages are protected by `user_passes_test`.
- Django's built-in admin remains available at `/django-admin/`.

## Important Routes

- `/login/`: custom `ThrottledLoginView`.
- `/logout/`: Django logout view, expected to be POSTed from the nav.
- `/` and `/calendar/`: weekly calendar.
- `/book/`: create a complete-crew booking.
- `/cancel/<booking_id>/`: cancel a booking by POST.
- `/my-bookings/`: bookings for the current user's linked athlete.
- `/admin/athletes/`: app-level athlete management.
- `/admin/slots/`: app-level concrete slot and batch slot creation.
- `/admin/bookings/`: app-level booking management.

## Booking Rules

The most important rules live in `bookings/forms.py` in `BookingForm.clean`.

- A booking is strict and complete: all rower seats must be filled.
- If `Boat.requires_cox` is true, one cox must also be selected.
- The same athlete cannot appear twice in the same booking.
- A boat can only have one booking per slot.
- An athlete cannot be booked into multiple boats in the same slot.
- Past slots cannot be booked.
- Admin-created bookings use the same validation as user-created bookings.

## Slots And Workouts

Slots are concrete date/time intervals. Recurrence is handled by `SlotBatch`,
which generates concrete `Slot` rows for matching weekdays over a date range.

Each slot can point to one reusable `Workout`, such as `S&C`, `Tecnica`, or
`4x3000 rest 10'`.

## Notifications

Booking email notifications are sent after transaction commit from views. The
recipient list includes active staff emails, linked crew user emails, previous
crew emails for updates/cancellations where relevant, and
`BOOKING_NOTIFICATION_EXTRA_RECIPIENTS`.

In local debug mode, Django uses the console email backend by default.

## Development Commands

```bash
python -m venv venv
pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py migrate
python setup_initial_data.py
python manage.py runserver
python manage.py test
```

Set `SECRET_KEY` before running Django commands.

## Common Change Entry Points

- Change booking validation: start in `bookings/forms.py`, then adjust tests.
- Change model relationships: start in `bookings/models.py`, then migrations/tests.
- Change calendar data/context: start in `bookings/views.py` and
  `bookings/templatetags/booking_extras.py`.
- Change rendered UI: inspect the relevant file under
  `bookings/templates/bookings/`, then CSS under
  `bookings/static/bookings/css/`.
- Change notification behavior: start in `bookings/notifications.py`, then tests.
- Change seed workouts/boats/slots/admin bootstrap: update `setup_initial_data.py`.
- Change deployment/runtime config: update `vogapp/settings.py` and `render.yaml`.
